title: Crazy gui by crazy maze
features:
⚡ Welcome to Crazy GUI (Public Edition) ⚡

Tired of bulky, laggy screen interfaces that cover half of your mobile or PC screen? Crazy GUI is a completely INVISIBLE exploit hub that runs 100% through the in-game text chat using advanced Markdown commands.

This project is entirely custom-made and written completely by hand. Zero AI junk, zero ChatGPT or Gemini generators. Just pure, optimized Lua performance. 

The brilliant concept and main design layout were originally borrowed from the old Local Maze profile. Now reconstructed, heavily upgraded, and publicly released by Crazy Maze!

🔥 FEATURES:
• [-# DisplayAttack:Name] -> A completely remote, powerful kill method that synchronizes with a hidden backend tool engine. Works perfectly by using either Username or Display Name! (Requires any tool equipped in your backpack).
• [-# ping] -> Quick network latency check with a classic Ping-Pong response.
• [-# fps] -> Real-time framerate counter featuring the "Frames Win Games" gaming rule.
• [-# meshbody] -> Instantly strips body meshes to glitch your hitbox and convert into a ghost mode.
• [-# meshtool] -> Clears active tool meshes.

🛡️ SAFETY & PROTECTION:
• Built-in background anti-moderator scanner. Automatically dislocates (kicks) you safely if an admin enters the server.
• Fully optimized with pcalls to prevent any red execution errors in your F9 console.

Supported Executors: Delta (Mobile), Xeno (PC), Wave, and all major level 7 executors.

changelog.message: This script uses chat commands with markdown formatting. It does not have a screen GUI. To test it, type "-# ping" or "-# fps" in the game chat after execution. The code is completely safe.
